title: Cleaner Night and Admin controls
summary: Reduce repeated controls so Night, Breaks and roster management stay focused on the information and actions that matter.
changes: Night and Breaks now focus on the live roster information itself, with the repeated copy-briefing, copy-breaks and email-roster controls removed.
Roster management keeps the useful Publish, Team, Access and Data sections, while Overview no longer repeats those same destinations as a second row of shortcut buttons.
Unused frontend code that existed only for the removed copy and email actions has been retired; roster calculations, staffing changes, breaks, chat, notifications and Supabase data remain unchanged.
